subject: Acme - follow-up: rate limits & overage terms
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Acme - follow-up: rate limits & overage terms

Hi Sarah — great talking earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment:

- Estimated usage (your call): ~5M tokens/day baseline, with launch-day bursts up to ~10M tokens/day.
- Budget range you mentioned: $5k–$10k/month initially.
- Target unit economics: you said a preferred target of ~$50/1M tokens (let me know if that was target or aspirational).

What I’ll send: our standard hosted pricing sheet (attached) and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) with options for temporary burst capacity, monthly committed tiers, and overage terms. Highlights now:
- Rate limits: hosted projects have a sustained quota (tokens/sec and requests/sec) and a burst buffer that can absorb short spikes (we typically allow up to 2–3x sustained for 24–72 hours depending on plan).
- Overage pricing: if you exceed committed monthly tokens, overage is charged at a higher unit cost; with a 3–6 month commit we can significantly reduce the overage rate.

Questions for you so I can tailor the MAP:
1) Do you expect sustained baseline to move above 5M tokens/day within the next 90 days?
2) What’s your preferred cadence for quotas — monthly committed tokens, or a committed QPS target?
3) Any internal procurement timing (PO window) we should plan for?

Next steps: I’ll send the pricing sheet and a draft MAP by EOD. Can we do a 30-min follow-up on Thu 4/15 to review numbers and an expedited quota request if needed?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Acme - follow-up: rate limits & overage terms

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Baseline: current pilot is ~5M tokens/day; with the Q2 launch we could see sustained ~7–8M/day and short bursts up to ~10M–12M/day for 48–72 hours.
- Budget: we’ve got $5k–$10k/mo in the early stage; there’s room to expand if the unit economics make sense.
- Target $/1M tokens: yes, we’re looking for ~ $50/1M as a target (that’s what the finance team is modeling).

Questions for you:
1) What would a temporary burst allowance look like (duration, how quickly can you enable)?
2) If we exceed a committed quota, what’s the overage rate and how are overages billed (immediately vs end-of-month)?
3) Lead time for permanent quota increases? We’d like the option to scale quickly during launch windows.

We’re available for the 4/15 slot. Please include any PO/contract timeline notes in the MAP.

—Sarah
Sarah Lin
Head of Product, Acme Corp
sarah.lin@acme.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-13T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme - follow-up: rate limits & overage terms

Thanks, Sarah — helpful detail. Here’s a concise answer to each question and a pricing sketch so finance can model: 

Burst allowance (temporary):
- Typical offering: up to 3x sustained quota for 24–72 hours as a temporary burst buffer.
- Enablement: standard requests processed in ~3 business days; expedited (operations pre-approved) can be turned on within 24 hours.

Quota increases:
- Standard lead time: 3 business days for larger increases.
- For launch windows we recommend requesting an elevated temporary quota 5–7 business days ahead; for true emergencies we can escalate.

Billing & overage pricing (sketch):
- Hosted list price (no commit): $120 / 1M tokens (billed monthly).
- Mid-tier committed volume (3–6 month commit): $80 / 1M tokens.
- Enterprise committed (annual, reserved capacity): $50–60 / 1M tokens depending on commit size and support SLAs.
- Overage handling: overages billed on next invoice at the overage rate associated with your commitment level; we can also set hard caps or email alerts before overage billing kicks in.

Given your $50/1M target, that maps to an annual/reserved or large commit conversation — I’ll flag that for our Commercial team. In the short term we can propose:
A) 3-month pilot: commit to a baseline (e.g., 150M tokens/mo) at $80/1M with a 48–72h temporary burst allowance and overage at $120/1M.
B) Enterprise trial: brief reserved capacity trial with target $50/1M if you can commit to a 12-month uplift and an expected monthly minimum.

I’ve attached the pricing sheet and a draft MAP. If you can confirm the baseline you expect to commit to for the pilot (tokens/month) I’ll put numbers into the MAP and loop in Commercial to draft formal terms/PO instructions.

Proposed next step: 30-min review on Thu 2027-04-15 10:00am PT?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Redwood-pricing-sheet-Q2-2027.pdf; Acme-draft-MAP-20270412.docx

Subject: Re: Acme - follow-up: rate limits & overage terms

Looping in operations notes for the thread so we have a clear playbook if Acme requests the burst: 

- Ops can approve a 48–72 hour burst up to 3x sustained without legal sign-off for pilot accounts, provided the customer agrees to standard T&Cs and prepayment for anticipated overage.
- For expedited enablement (<24h) we need a written request and a Billing PO or card on file; otherwise we’ll process in ~3 business days.
- Overage billing: billed end-of-month on the invoice; we can issue a proforma estimate mid-cycle if requested.

If Marissa confirms their baseline and preferred pilot commit we’ll prepare an ops-ready enablement request and a short SOW if needed.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai

Appreciate the detail — that all looks reasonable. Next items from our side: 

1) We’ll plan a pilot commit of ~150M tokens/month to start (roughly in-line with the 5–8M/day sustained you noted). Please model the MAP at $80/1M for the 3-month pilot and show overage at $120/1M.
2) For the launch window (scheduled ~4/28–4/30) we’ll request the temporary 3x burst for 72 hours; please advise how to formally submit that request so we can align procurement timelines.
3) PO process: our finance team typically needs a quote + SOW to raise a PO; we expect 7–10 business days to issue a PO once they have the doc.

We’re confirmed for Thu 4/15 10:00am PT — please send the MAP and a short quote ahead of the call so finance can prep. Thanks!

—Sarah
Sarah Lin
Head of Product, Acme Corp
